olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Find all integers $n\geq 3$ such that if $1=d_1<d_2<\cdots<d_k=n!$ are divisors of $n!$, then $d_2-d_1\leq d_3-d_2\leq\cdots\leq d_k-d_{k-1}$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2024

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Finite sets $S_1,\ldots,S_{100}$ of integers with nonempty intersection. For each nonempty $T\subseteq\{S_1,\ldots,S_{100}\}$, $|\bigcap T|$ is a multiple of $|T|$. Find the least possible number of elements in at least 50 sets.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2024

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: A triangulation of a polygon is $m$-balanced if its triangles can be colored with $m$ colors so that all same-color triangles have equal total area. Find all $n$ for which a regular $n$-gon has an $m$-balanced triangulation.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2024

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: A circular necklace has $mn$ beads, each red or blue. No matter how the necklace is cut into $m$ blocks of $n$ consecutive beads, each block has a distinct number of red beads. Find all $(m,n)$ for which this is possible.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2024

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $D$ inside acute $\triangle ABC$ with $\angle DAC=\angle ACB$ and $\angle BDC=90^\circ+\angle BAC$. $E$ on ray $BD$ with $AE=EC$; $M$ = midpoint of $BC$. Show line $AB$ is tangent to the circumcircle of $\triangle BEM$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2024

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Let $n>2$ be an integer, $\ell\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. A collection $A_1,\ldots,A_k\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ is $\ell$-large if $|A_i|\geq\ell$ for all $i$. Find the largest $c$ (in terms of $n,\ell$) such that $\sum_{i,j}x_ix_j\frac{|A_i\cap A_j|^2}{|A_i||A_j|}\geq c\left(\sum_i x_i\right)^2$ for all $k\geq 1$, nonneg­ative $x_i$, and $\ell$-large collections.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2024
